title: More ways to see where Pollen goes
summary:
Usage exports and model-restricted keys landed alongside clearer Pollen balances, a Seedance video fix, and some care for community apps.

Added `/api/usage` with JSON and CSV exports, timestamp pagination, and a dashboard CSV download. The dashboard now shows recent spend pending against the Pollen balance, while balance checks account for that spend before allowing more requests. Image-pricing labels also make flat per-image costs easier to distinguish from prompt-dependent token costs. The usage work also added a separate frontend for generation, model discovery, API docs, and app browsing.

Key settings now let users choose which text, image, and video models a key may access. Generation checks those permissions after resolving model aliases; unrestricted keys keep access to all models.

Seedance Pro now passes `aspectRatio` through to video generation instead of ignoring it, including portrait requests such as 9:16. Requests without a ratio default to 16:9.

highlights.title: Export your usage
highlights.text: Inspect usage through `/api/usage`, paginate by timestamp, or export JSON or CSV. The dashboard has a CSV download too. [API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Choose models per API key
highlights.text: Set which text, image, and video models an API key can use. Requests for models outside its allowed list are rejected, even when they use an alias. [Manage keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: A new place to explore
highlights.text: A separate frontend brings a generation playground, model discovery, API documentation, an app directory, and a theme editor together.
